reason: Adds adeu to wave 1 under the frozen protocol, before its first capture.
rule: adeu 3.0.6 runs each attempt in its own container (--network none, user 65534, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, source read-only). The host adapter maps a task to adeu's documented operations: ModifyText for tracked replacements, ReplyComment and a comment-only ModifyText (target equal to new text) for K5, AcceptChange/RejectChange for K6 with Chg:N and Com:N taken from the source XML by author and text. adeu writes only tracked changes, so plain replacements are unsupported. adeu stamps new revisions with the current time; the evaluator does not score the editor's dates. capture refuses an adapter that is not declared.
